title: Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 — Section 25T (Prohibition of unfair labour practice)

content.overview: Section 25T prohibits any employer, workman or trade union from committing any unfair labour practice.
content.glance: Section 25T prohibits any employer, workman or trade union from committing any unfair labour practice.
content.study: No employer or workman or a trade union, whether registered or not, shall commit any unfair labour practice. The practices are listed in the Fifth Schedule.
